p: Jehoiada the priest instructed him: As long as rulers give ear to the true ministers of God, they prosper.
the high places were not taken: So hard a thing it is for them, that are in authority, to be brought to the perfect obedience of God.
account: That is, the money of redemption Ex 30:12, also the money which the priest valued the vows at Le 27:2, and their free gift.

breaches of the house: For the temple which was built a hundred and fifty-five years before, had many things decayed in it, both by the negligence of the king's predecessors, and also by the wickedness of the idolaters.
receive no more money of your: He takes from them the ordering of the money, because of their negligence.
right side as one cometh into: That is, on the south side.
that did the work: For the king had appointed others who were fit for that purpose, 2Ki 22:5.
not made for the house of: For these men only had charge of the repairing of the temple, the rest of the money was brought to the king who caused these to be made later, 2Ch 24:14.

sent it to Hazael king of: After the death of Jehoiada, Joash fell to idolatry: therefore God rejected him, and stirred up his enemy against him, whom he pacified with the treasures of the temple: for God would not be served with those gifts, seeing the king's heart was wicked.
slew Joash in the house of: Because he had put Zachariah the son of Jehoiada to death, 2Ch 24:25.
